headline: Chiefs score their first points!
what_happened: H.Butker successfully kicked a 46-yard field goal, which is a kick through the goalposts worth three points.
who: H.Butker, J.Winchester, and M.Araiza executed the kick for Kansas City.
why_it_matters: This score is great news for the Chiefs because it puts them on the board and improves their chances of winning by 2 percentage points.
